# appdynamics_users (Data Source)

Lists the RBAC users in the current AppDynamics account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_users" "all" {}

output "user_names" {
  value = { for u in data.appdynamics_users.all.users : u.id => u.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
